mapper.sql: r.id, r.workspace_id, r.req_id, r.name, r.provider, r.repo_url, r.project_ref, r.default_target, r.token_cipher, r.import_policy, r.sync_enabled, r.last_sync_at, r.last_sync_status, r.last_sync_error, r.last_sync_summary, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at, req.name AS req_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM project_repo r LEFT JOIN requirement req ON req.id = r.req_id AND req.workspace_id = r.workspace_id WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY r.created_at, r.id
SELECT FROM project_repo r LEFT JOIN requirement req ON req.id = r.req_id AND req.workspace_id = r.workspace_id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT FROM project_repo r LEFT JOIN requirement req ON req.id = r.req_id AND req.workspace_id = r.workspace_id WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND r.repo_url = #{repoUrl} AND r.project_ref = #{projectRef}

SELECT FROM project_repo r LEFT JOIN requirement req ON req.id = r.req_id AND req.workspace_id = r.workspace_id WHERE r.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND r.req_id = #{reqId} ORDER BY r.created_at, r.id

SELECT FROM project_repo r LEFT JOIN requirement req ON req.id = r.req_id AND req.workspace_id = r.workspace_id WHERE r.sync_enabled = 1 AND (r.last_sync_at IS NULL OR r.last_sync_at <= #{before}) ORDER BY r.last_sync_at IS NOT NULL, r.last_sync_at, r.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_repo (id, workspace_id, req_id, name, provider, repo_url, project_ref, default_target, token_cipher, import_policy, sync_enabled, last_sync_at, last_sync_status, last_sync_error, last_sync_summary, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{reqId}, #{name}, #{provider}, #{repoUrl}, #{projectRef}, #{defaultTarget}, #{tokenCipher}, #{importPolicy}, #{syncEnabled}, #{lastSyncAt}, #{lastSyncStatus}, #{lastSyncError}, #{lastSyncSummary}, #{createdBy}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE project_repo SET req_id = #{reqId}, name = #{name}, provider = #{provider}, repo_url = #{repoUrl}, project_ref = #{projectRef}, default_target = #{defaultTarget}, token_cipher = #{tokenCipher}, import_policy = #{importPolicy}, sync_enabled = #{syncEnabled}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
UPDATE project_repo SET sync_enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

UPDATE project_repo SET last_sync_at = #{at}, last_sync_status = #{status}, last_sync_error = #{error}, last_sync_summary = #{summary}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
UPDATE project_repo SET token_cipher = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_repo WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
DELETE FROM project_repo WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId}
